tbesh_html:
1) cord, rope, cordage, foliage, interwoven foliage
1a) cord, rope, cordage, chain
1b) interwoven foliage

strongs_1890.strongs_def: something intwined, i.e. a string, wreath or foliage
strongs_1890.derivation: or עֲבוֹת; or (feminine) עֲבֹתָה; the same as H5687 (עָבֹת);
strongs_1890.kjv_def: band, cord, rope, thick bough (branch), wreathen (chain).
